summary.name: Krisp
summary.one_liner: Krisp is a Voice AI platform that removes background noise from calls and meetings and provides AI transcription, note-taking, and accent conversion across several separately installed products.
use_cases: cancel background noise during online calls
transcribe and summarize Zoom or Teams meetings
add noise cancellation to a developer's app
real-time agent support in contact centers
summary.what_it_does: Krisp is a Voice AI platform built on a shared AI voice engine. Its AI Meeting Assistant is a bot-free note taker that transcribes and takes notes across Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Slack Huddles and other conferencing apps. Call Center AI targets contact centers with accent conversion, voice translation, noise cancellation and agent assist. The AI Voice SDK lets developers embed noise cancellation, accent conversion and voice isolation into their own apps. Noise cancellation works at the audio level, so it applies across conferencing apps. Transcription supports custom vocabulary of up to 750 words.
notable: Bot-free AI meeting note taker that works at the audio level across conferencing apps
On-device English transcription, with server-based transcription in 15 additional languages
Custom vocabulary up to 750 words for names, acronyms and technical terms
Separate products share one voice AI engine but are installed individually
caveats: Mobile app does not yet include Noise Cancellation (stated as coming)
Each product is installed separately; installing one does not include the others
Transcription accuracy depends mostly on speaker clarity and microphone
